"How often does AI make stuff up?"

Confidence: It depends It makes things up — but less, and less randomly, than the panic suggests. How often depends entirely on what you ask: hand it a document to summarize and the top models are very reliable; ask it to recall a fact from memory and it's much shakier. What's solid — There is no honest single hallucination rate.…

11.6 — Hallucination: Why It Makes Things Up

You've probably experienced this: you ask an AI to recommend a book, and it gives you a title, an author, a publication year, even a one-paragraph summary. It sounds perfect. You search for it and the book doesn't exist. The author is real. The topic is real. The title is plausible. But the book was never written. The model didn't lie to you — it has no concept of lying.…

1.2 — What Isn't AI (And Why It Still Matters)

Now that you've seen the seam in one place, let's make sure it holds up everywhere. Here are things you use every day that are impressive, useful, sometimes even remarkable — but are not AI. Your calculator. You type 7 × 8. It says 56. It will always say 56. A human being wrote the multiplication rules into it decades ago, and it follows those rules every single time, perfectly, without deviation.…
